paper_title: Sleep stage prediction with raw acceleration and photoplethysmography heart rate data derived from a consumer wearable device
data_modality: Apple Watch raw triaxial accelerometer + PPG-derived heart rate, labeled against in-lab polysomnography (31 subjects, Univ. of Michigan)
analysis_method: Hand-built features (motion, local SD of heart rate, circadian 'clock proxy') fed to logistic regression, random forest, kNN, and a small neural net; validated out-of-sample on MESA
medical_outcome_predicted: Sleep/wake classification and 3-class wake vs NREM vs REM staging
reported_result: 90% of epochs correctly classified for sleep/wake (sensitivity 93% for sleep, specificity 59.6% for wake); ~72% accuracy for wake/NREM/REM with all features. Generalized to MESA cohort with comparable performance.
data_availability: OPEN - full raw dataset on PhysioNet 'sleep-accel' v1.0.0 + NSRR SleepAccel; original MATLAB/Python code public
apple_watch_feasibility: HIGH - CMMotionManager gives raw accelerometer at 50Hz and HealthKit gives HR; every input is reproducible on a consumer Apple Watch today
source_citation: Walch O, Huang Y, Forger D, Goldstein C. https://academic.oup.com/sleep/article/42/12/zsz180/5549536 | dataset: https://physionet.org/content/sleep-accel/1.0.0/

paper_title: Beyond Sensor Data: Foundation Models of Behavioral Data from Wearables Improve Health Predictions
data_modality: 27 human-interpretable behavioral metrics derived by Apple Watch/iPhone - step count, sleep duration, HRV, respiratory rate, walking pace, active energy, mobility - over 2.5B hours from 162K Apple Heart & Movement Study participants
analysis_method: Self-supervised 'Wearable Behavior Model' (WBM) foundation model; Mamba-2 state-space backbone with tokenization tuned for weekly behavioral blocks; linear probes on frozen embeddings
medical_outcome_predicted: 57 health tasks spanning static conditions (e.g. chronic disease status) and dynamic states (pregnancy, sleep quality, respiratory infection)
reported_result: Beat a strong raw-PPG foundation model on 18/47 static tasks and on all but one dynamic task; best combined performance when behavioral + raw-sensor embeddings are fused. Press-reported up to ~92% accuracy on the strongest tasks (e.g. pregnancy detection).
data_availability: CLOSED - AHMS data is Apple-internal; no weights or data released
apple_watch_feasibility: HIGH for the *inputs* - all 27 metrics are standard HealthKit quantity types you can export today. LOW for the model itself (no released checkpoint) - you would train your own small model on the same feature schema.
source_citation: Erturk E, Kamran F, Abbaspourazad S, Jewell S, Sharma H, Li Y, Williamson S, Foti NJ, Futoma J. https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00191

paper_title: Large-scale Training of Foundation Models for Wearable Biosignals
data_modality: Raw Apple Watch PPG waveforms and single-lead ECG from ~141,000 Apple Heart & Movement Study participants over ~3 years
analysis_method: Self-supervised contrastive pretraining - participant-level positive pair selection, stochastic augmentation module, regularized contrastive loss with momentum training; evaluated by linear probing frozen embeddings
medical_outcome_predicted: Demographics (age, sex, BMI) and health conditions/medication status encoded in the biosignal embeddings
reported_result: Frozen PPG and ECG embeddings encode demographic and health information and outperform supervised-from-scratch baselines on downstream probes; first foundation models trained on consumer-wearable-scale PPG/ECG.
data_availability: CLOSED - no data or weights released
apple_watch_feasibility: LOW-MEDIUM - Apple does NOT expose raw PPG waveforms to third-party apps; single-lead ECG is exportable only as a per-recording waveform via HealthKit. Reproducing this needs an external PPG sensor or the ECG-only path.
source_citation: Abbaspourazad S, Elachqar O, Miller AC, Emrani S, Nallasamy U, Shapiro I. https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.05409

paper_title: Photoplethysmography-Based Machine Learning Approaches for Atrial Fibrillation Burden: Algorithm Development and Validation
data_modality: Smartwatch PPG pulse-interval data from patients with paroxysmal AF (prospective pilot, Chinese PLA General Hospital, Jan 2024-Jan 2025), referenced against 24-hour Holter
analysis_method: Supervised ML classifier over PPG-derived beat intervals, aggregated into a continuous AF *burden* estimate (fraction of time in AF) rather than a single yes/no detection
medical_outcome_predicted: Atrial fibrillation burden / AF progression tracking
reported_result: Sensitivity 91.5%, specificity 97.2%, precision 92.9%, accuracy 93.3%, F1 90.5% vs 24h Holter; AUC 0.895 in the test cohort for the burden model.
data_availability: CLOSED - clinical cohort not public; several open PPG-AF datasets exist as substitutes (e.g. DeepBeat, MIMIC PERform AF)
apple_watch_feasibility: MEDIUM - raw PPG is unavailable, but Apple Watch exposes irregular-rhythm notifications and an 'AFib History' burden percentage in HealthKit, so the *output* of this paper is directly comparable to a shipped Apple feature

paper_title: Detection of Common Respiratory Infections, Including COVID-19, Using Consumer Wearable Devices in Health Care Workers: Prospective Model Validation Study
data_modality: Nocturnal physiology from consumer smartwatch (Fitbit Sense / Versa 3): resting heart rate, respiratory rate, and two HRV metrics measured during sleep, plus age/sex/BMI
analysis_method: CNN over a 5x4 matrix (4 physiological features x 5 days) with z-score normalization; prospective validation in health care workers against PCR
medical_outcome_predicted: Pre-symptomatic / early detection of COVID-19 and other upper respiratory infections
reported_result: Detected 90% of PCR-confirmed COVID-19 cases (28/31) and 79% of all respiratory-virus cases (63/80) within an 8-day predictive window; false-positive rate 2% per prediction day; PPV only 4-10%; 63.6% of alerts traced to stress/exercise/poor sleep rather than infection.
data_availability: CLOSED cohort, but the method is trivially re-implementable; open analogues exist (Stanford Snyder-lab COVID wearable dataset)
apple_watch_feasibility: HIGH - device was Fitbit, but all four inputs map 1:1 onto HealthKit types on Apple Watch (restingHeartRate, respiratoryRate, heartRateVariabilitySDNN, sleep stages). Straight port, no raw sensor access needed.

paper_title: Apple Watch Sleep Apnea Notification (Breathing Disturbances) - FDA De Novo/510(k) clinical validation
venue: FDA clearance (Sept 2024) + Apple clinical validation study
data_modality: Apple Watch wrist accelerometer, sampled continuously during sleep, converted into a per-night 'Breathing Disturbances' metric; SpO2 and heart rate as supporting signals
analysis_method: Proprietary classifier mapping accelerometer-derived breathing disturbance elevation over a 30-day window (>=10 tracked nights) to moderate-to-severe sleep apnea risk
reported_result: Cleared on a study of N=1448 spanning AHI <5 (normal) to >=30 (severe). Explicitly a *notification* feature, not a diagnostic - Apple states it is not intended to diagnose, treat, or manage sleep apnea.
data_availability: CLOSED algorithm; the Breathing Disturbances metric itself IS readable from HealthKit (appleSleepingBreathingDisturbances)
apple_watch_feasibility: HIGH - you can read Apple's own per-night breathing-disturbance values plus raw accelerometer, so you can both consume the shipped metric and try to beat it with your own model on open PSG data (e.g. MESA, SHHS)
